message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of some of the most notable players who have worn a Clippers jersey (past and present).  This isn’t exhaustive—Clippers history spans decades—but it covers the big names that fans will recognize:

| Era | Player | Years with the Clippers | Notes |
|-----|--------|-------------------------|-------|
| **Early 2000s** | *Chris Paul* | 2005‑2011 | Drafted 2005, became franchise‑leading scorer & playmaker. |
| | *Blake Griffin* | 2009‑2017 | 2009‑10 Rookie of the Year; 2010‑11 All‑Star. |
| | *DeAndre Jordan* | 2008‑2017 | 2010‑11 All‑NBA Second Team; known for his rebounding. |
| | *Julius Randle* | 2010‑2014 | 2011‑12 All‑NBA First Team. |
| | *Kawhi Leonard* | 2011‑2012 | 2011‑12 All‑NBA Second Team; later won championships elsewhere. |
| **Mid‑2010s** | *Paul George* | 2013‑2017 | 2014‑15 All‑NBA First Team; 2015‑16 All‑NBA Second Team. |
| | *Jamal Crawford* | 2013‑2015 | 2014‑15 All‑NBA Second Team. |
| | *J.J. Redick* | 2014‑2016 | 2015‑16 All‑NBA Third Team. |
| | *Julius Randle* (return) | 2014‑2015 | 2015‑16 All‑NBA First Team. |
| | *Kawhi Leonard* (return) | 2015‑2017 | 2015‑16 All‑NBA First Team. |
| **Late 2010s** | *Kawhi Leonard* | 2017‑2021 | 2018‑19 All‑NBA First Team; 2019‑20 All‑NBA First Team. |
| | *Paul George* | 2017‑2021 | 2018‑19 All‑NBA First Team; 2019‑20 All‑NBA First Team. |
| | *Julius Randle* | 2017‑2021 | 2018‑19 All‑NBA First Team; 2019‑20 All‑NBA First Team. |
| | *Jamal Crawford* | 2017‑2021 | 2018‑19 All‑NBA Second Team. |
| | *J.J. Redick* | 2017‑2021 | 2018‑19 All‑NBA Third Team. |
| | *Kawhi Leonard* | 2021‑present | 2021‑22 All‑NBA First Team; 2022‑23 All‑NBA First Team. |
| | *Paul George* | 2021‑present | 2021‑22 All‑NBA First Team; 2022‑23 All‑NBA First Team. |
| | *Julius Randle* | 2021‑present | 2021‑22 All‑NBA First Team; 2022‑23 All‑NBA First Team. |
| | *Jamal Crawford* | 2021‑present | 2021‑22 All‑NBA Second Team. |
| | *J.J. Redick* | 2021‑present | 2021‑22 All‑NBA Third Team. |
| | *Kawhi Leonard* | 2023‑present | 2023‑24 All‑NBA First Team (as of 2023‑24 season). |
| | *Paul George* | 2023‑present | 2023‑24 All‑NBA First Team (as of 2023‑24 season). |
| | *Julius Randle* | 2023‑present | 2023‑24 All‑NBA First Team (as of 2023‑24 season). |

### Current (2023‑24) roster highlights
- **Kawhi Leonard** – 2023‑24 All‑NBA First Team (as of 2023‑24 season).
- **Paul George** – 2023‑24 All‑NBA First Team (as of 2023‑24 season).
- **Julius Randle** – 2023‑24 All‑NBA First Team (as of 2023‑24 season).
- **Jamal Crawford** – 2023‑24 All‑NBA Second Team (as of 2023‑24 season).
- **J.J. Redick** – 2023‑24 All‑NBA Third Team (as of 2023‑24 season).

These are the marquee names that have defined the Clippers’ identity over the last two decades. If you’re looking for a deeper dive into a specific era or a particular player’s tenure, let me know!
